summary: WeeWX is an open-source Python application designed to interface with hardware weather stations and process meteorological data. It collects sensor readings, generates graphical reports, and manages archival records on your own hardware.
goodFor: It suits technical users who want to host their own weather logging pipeline and retain full ownership of their sensor data without relying on vendor cloud services.
watchOut: Configuration relies on text files and Python-based templating, which can present a steep learning curve if you need to customise outputs or troubleshoot hardware communication errors.
deployNotes: Because it runs on Python and package formats like deb, you will typically need persistent storage for your historical weather databases and a reverse proxy if you plan to serve the generated reports securely over HTTPS.
